column3: In collection, vehicle and Secret Missions lists, press Right to toggle a checkmark. OK opens details; Check/Undo (or Check/Uncheck) changes the saved status. Progress is stored on the SD card. Secret Mission chapter gates marked ? are estimates.

Press Right (Emulate) to start the best map or link immediately. maps come first. Press OK during NFC to browse multiple links, then Up/Down and OK to select. Tap your unlocked phone. Back stops NFC and returns to the checklist with the item highlighted.
Dispatch: select a region. OK checks or undoes the stop. Left (Next) advances to the next unchecked stop. Right (Emulate) opens the location reference when available. Back returns to the region menu.

To use: finish the story and the individual cheat's unlock challenge. Check Progress > Cheats. In free roam press D-pad Up to open phone. Hold L1 and R1 (PS5) or LB and RB (Xbox), then enter the D-pad code.

Story Mode only. Save before entering a cheat: saving and trophies/achievements may be disabled for that session. Restart and reload a pre-cheat save to resume normal progress. [?] means the input is unavailable; unverified codes are test sequences, not confirmed cheats. Xbox button conversions may differ from working game inputs.

Keep manual saves before Tourist Trap (C1) and Checking Out (C2). In C2 pay Linda before Slam Dunk, collect Starlet Motel cards and books, and help Wyman at his car before moving. In C3 take Gil’s pistol in Safe Word and Monty’s pistol in The Missing Link. Pete’s rifle is a C4 mission pickup. Shirley’s errands, Yago’s limited race, Shayna’s ride, Yasmani’s one-day ATM tip and some optional bank jobs may be missable. See Optional Missions and Special Weapons for individual requirements.

Chapter 2: finish Girl's Trip and start Take a Vehicle to Moses as Lucia. Keep the first registration unused. WAiNK-scan a candidate: tracker NONE, eligible and a free garage slot. Drive to Watkins Auto Parts, Port Gellhorn. Complete Moses' tutorial. If prompted, choose Find Another instead of spending the waiver on the tutorial car. Bring the car you want. Open Services (PS5: L2 then Square; Xbox: LT then X), Respray, then Register. Both first services should show FREE. Confirm ownership and check Scooter Bros.\n\nBison: reported 6 cargo slots; Dominator: 2. Montagne XL waits behind Watkins. Choose a useful cargo vehicle or save the waiver for a high-value car (see Free Thrax glitch). Subsequent registrations normally cost money; no reproducible unlimited free method established. Chapter 3 Pay 'n' Spray reportedly accepts Standard trackers after story unlock; Advanced tracker registration: complete Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, progress Randy's Wish List, finish Dale Mamba and receive Randy's call. Key Cloner alone is not enough. Advanced tracker registration is also reported in Chapter 4; check the Register option.

Stunts: 250 for the trophy, 300 for 100% completion. A successful bridge pass or stunt jump gives credit; bonus objectives are optional. Map > Exploration > Stunt Spots: purple = found, white = completed. The Lapwing Mallard reportedly fits all bridges. Avoid touching the water or bridge.

Basketball: score at 90 distinct hoops for 100%; check Record > Activities > Sports > Basketball.

Pool: beat opponents at five distinct venues for 100%; all seven reportedly unlock a tattoo. A story match that ends early may not count. Golf: complete two different mini-golf courses for 100%.

Destroy cocaine flamingos with black-and-white beaks. Black-and-yellow beaks are decorative; loose cocaine is optional. Destroy 100 of the reported 125 figures for 100% completion. Use Focus if unsure which figure can be destroyed.

Scan hair, makeup and tattoo magazines with WAiNK; pick up watches directly. Discover 70 styles for 100% completion. Collecting 10 watches reportedly unlocks Move Time Forward; 20 unlocks Pause Time of Day.\n\nHair appears under Magazine Styles at salons; tattoos under Awards for the appropriate body part. Watches appear in wardrobe Accessories > Watches. Buying an unlocked style is not reportedly required for discovery credit. Paired tattoo magazines can unlock designs for both characters.

Island Dreams unlocks diving. Equip scuba gear and select the metal detector from the lower-right weapon wheel. Follow chest markers; dig when the detector turns green, then open the chest.\n\nComplete the first two treasure sets, sell them to Kenton and complete Check in with Kenton to unlock three more. Maritime Dispute requires Chapter 3 Jason and prior Kenton progress; finish it to access the final two sites. Check Progress > Contacts > Kenton Rees > Shipwrecks Cleared. Five of seven treasure sets and all 33 underwater discoveries are reported completion targets. Del Ocio’s 10 Gold Doubloons are separate. To sell relics, focus on Kenton at Island Dreams Boat Charters (L2/LT), then select Treasures (Circle/B).

Strangers & Freaks: complete the eight reported qualifying strands: Merle (Final Flush), Freddie (Retest), Kirk (Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (Buddy?), Alvan (Missing Person), Yago (Brother to Brother), Papa Audacity (The Audacity) and Pilot Pete (last delivery). Credit is awarded at the strand finale. Messages in Bottles do not count toward the 34 books and swaps.\n\nStick Ups: unlock after Girls’ Trip (C2); complete 50 for 100%. Check Map > Robberies > Stick Ups before robbing a store. A robbery card alone does not establish eligibility. For Illegal Operations, clear every marked key valuable; ordinary bank jobs are separate.

Study any 100 animals for 100% completion. Use binoculars and hold R1/RB at the study prompt; aquatic species can be studied while swimming nearby. Catching fish is separate.

Fishing: buy lures at Ammu-Nation stores with a fish icon. D-pad Right changes lures. Medium freshwater lure $45; medium saltwater $56; large saltwater $125, reportedly available in Chapter 3. The Fish Log updates after a catch.

Bret: small carcasses fit in vehicle trunks. As Jason, photograph large game at the carcass to request collection, then leave the area for payment. Wait if Bret is still processing a previous pickup. See the active Target Deck for species and weapon requirements.

Protein after training halves recovery time. The anabolic window lasts one day; finish workouts within it. Sleep restores health and focus and temporarily improves stamina. Cardio options include gym treadmill, stationary bike and punching bag, plus outdoor running, swimming, cycling and kayaking. Gym access can depend on story or police restrictions. Ajax may be unavailable while Lucia is undercover.

Open the artist 1010 post in Snapmatic. Stand on each marked viewpoint and photograph the artwork with the phone camera; WAiNK scans do not count. For Crosstown, wait for the painted train to stop. After all five photos, follow the reward clue to Southside Storage east of the airport beside Slator Towing. Enter 1010 for the custom Cheetah and reported free garage.

At a pawn shop, open Collectible Cards to view the sell offer by set. Map price covers all collectibles held. A sold card remains visible in Progress; verify the collection counter before selling a set if completion is your priority.

Store, bank and some mission safe codes vary between runs or saves.

Check back-office notes, whiteboards, maps, computers or guards for clues. Press L3 + R3 to activate Focus Mode. Use the Safe Code? dialogue prompt during robberies when available. Check Notes on the keypad if the clue has been collected.

If a code fails, check the local clue. Keep leading zeros. Some keypads accept five or six digits; some computers accept words.

Sticky bombs can open some safes but attract enemies or police. Locked mission doors and garage keypads may not respond to explosives.
